title: The Facade of Truth: Uncovering and Mitigating LLM Susceptibility to Deceptive Evidence

summary.claim: LLMs filter obvious misinformation but are easily misled by polished, hard-to-falsify evidence: belief in false claims rises by 93% on average. DIS, which infers deceptive intent and warns early, reduces this.
summary.condition: MisBelief data: 4,800 instances made by role-playing LLMs, three difficulty levels; 7 LLMs evaluated.
summary.gap: (Inferred) Only generated evidence is tested, so the effect size on real human-crafted misinformation is unknown.
